description: The Proactive Messages log: each proactive message a visitor saw, newest first: the rule, when, on which page, in which language, the text, and what the visitor did (opened the chat, closed the bubble, replied). The visitor's name or email is there when the website sends it with User Context. A replied entry has a link to the conversation. Use it to see who saw a message and whether a rule works.

before_id.description: For the next page: the smallest entry id of the previous answer.

rule_id.description: Only this rule's entries. Omit for every rule.

website_id.description: Numeric id of the website, from list_websites. Omit to use the account's primary website.

name: list_proactive_message_log
title: Read the Proactive Messages log
